news.headline: DCTH Screens as a Momentum Leader After a 31% Four-Week Run, Trading at 98% of Its 52-Week Range
news.summary: Delcath gained 31.1% over the prior four weeks and 58.7% over twelve weeks, trading at 97.9% of its 52-week high-low range with a Zacks Rank of #2 (Buy). The average of five analyst targets sits at $21.80 (range $20-$25), implying roughly 35% upside from the current $16.15.

news.headline: Delcath Sets Fresh 52-Week High at $17.42 as BTIG and H.C. Wainwright Lift Targets
news.summary: DCTH pushed to a new 52-week high of $17.42 as the post-earnings rally extended with a further 10% move on 2026-08-10, after BTIG raised its target to $21 from $17 and H.C. Wainwright to $32 from $30, both Buy. Zacks Research upgraded the stock from Hold to Strong Buy on 2026-08-12.

news.headline: Management Presents at Canaccord Genuity's 46th Annual Growth Conference in Boston
news.summary: Delcath management attended the Canaccord Genuity 46th Annual Growth Conference in Boston on 2026-08-11, five days after the Q2 beat, pitching the HEPZATO KIT and CHEMOSAT commercial story to institutional healthcare investors. The appearance came in the middle of the run to the 52-week high and coincided with the round of target raises.

news.headline: Delcath Reports Q2 2026: $29.1M Revenue Beats Estimates, FY Guidance Raised to $104M-$108M
news.summary: Total revenue rose to $29.1M from $24.2M a year earlier (HEPZATO KIT $27.1M, CHEMOSAT $2.0M) on roughly 30% HEPZATO volume growth, with gross margin expanding to 90% from 86%, net income of $2.7M and EPS of $0.07 versus a consensus loss of $0.09 (a $0.16-$0.17 beat). Delcath raised FY2026 revenue guidance to $104M-$108M with FY gross margin of 86%-89% and reiterated positive adjusted EBITDA for the year; cash and investments stood at $95.9M with no debt, and the stock jumped more than 20% on the print.

news.headline: Q2 Call: 31 Active Centers Heading to ~37, mCRC Phase 2 Screening at 13 Sites
news.summary: Management exited Q2 with 31 active HEPZATO treatment centers and guided to roughly six more activations by year-end, and said the company-sponsored Phase 2 of HEPZATO in metastatic colorectal cancer now has 13 centers actively screening after site additions and specialized training. The call also flagged rising use of HEPZATO in combination with systemic therapy in metastatic uveal melanoma and independent ESMO Breast Cancer 2026 data showing a 60% hepatic partial response rate with percutaneous hepatic perfusion in heavily pretreated liver-dominant metastatic breast cancer.

news.headline: BlackRock Discloses 5.3% Passive Stake in Delcath Systems
news.summary: BlackRock reported beneficial ownership of 1,836,121 DCTH shares, or 5.3% of the class, with an event date of 2026-06-30 (sole voting power over 1,807,103 shares). Crossing the 5% threshold on a share count of only about 34.7M marks the kind of large passive-index and institutional accumulation that typically follows a small cap's move into sustained commercial revenue.

catalysts.label: Q3 2026 earnings
catalysts.detail: The next quarterly report is expected in early-to-mid November 2026 based on prior-year timing; no exact date has been announced yet. It is the first checkpoint on whether HEPZATO volume growth and center activations are tracking the raised full-year guidance, and the last print before FY2026 guidance has to be delivered.

catalysts.label: ~37 active HEPZATO treatment centers
catalysts.detail: Delcath exited Q2 2026 with 31 active HEPZATO KIT centers and guided to roughly six additional activations by year-end, taking the network to about 37. Center count is the most direct driver of near-term revenue, so the pace of the final activations is the key operational metric to watch.

catalysts.label: FY2026 revenue $104M-$108M and positive adjusted EBITDA
catalysts.detail: Raised guidance implies at least 28% HEPZATO volume growth over 2025, with full-year gross margin guided to 86%-89% after Q2 printed 90%. Management also guided to positive adjusted EBITDA for the full year, which would mark the transition to a self-funding commercial model and, with $95.9M of cash and no debt, remove the dilution overhang that has capped the multiple.

catalysts.label: mCRC Phase 2 enrollment progress
catalysts.detail: The company-sponsored Phase 2 trial of HEPZATO in metastatic colorectal cancer had 13 centers actively screening as of the Q2 call, with recruitment improving after added sites and specialized training. Enrollment milestones and eventual data would open the largest liver-dominant indication in the pipeline by a wide margin.

catalysts.label: DELUMA breast cancer Phase 2 enrollment and data
catalysts.detail: The roughly 90-patient randomized Phase 2 in HER2-negative liver-dominant metastatic breast cancer (NCT06875128) began dosing in July 2026 at the European Institute of Oncology in Milan and is enrolling across US and EU sites. Full enrollment and first efficacy readouts are the next major pipeline catalysts, supported by independent ESMO retrospective data showing a 60% hepatic partial response rate.

pulse: Delcath is in the strongest stretch of its commercial story so far: Q2 2026 revenue of $29.1M beat by roughly $3M, gross margin hit 90%, EPS flipped to $0.07 against an expected loss, and FY guidance was lifted to $104M-$108M with positive adjusted EBITDA expected and $95.9M of cash against no debt. The stock spiked more than 20% on the print, ran to a 52-week high of $17.42 on 2026-08-12 and has held nearly all of it -- trading around $16.15 on 2026-08-31 for a market cap of roughly $560M on just 34.7M shares -- with BTIG at $21, H.C. Wainwright at $32, a Zacks upgrade and BlackRock now disclosed at a 5.3% stake. With no company news since the Q2 print, the market's focus is pure execution: getting from 31 to about 37 active HEPZATO centers by year-end and proving the raised guidance at the November Q3 report, while DELUMA in breast cancer and the 13-center mCRC Phase 2 carry the longer-dated optionality beyond ocular melanoma.
